name: parenting-advisor
title_zh: 把育儿难题变成可执行的每日行动清单
tagline_zh: 孩子哭闹、作业拖拉、亲子冲突……别再翻十本育儿书。装了这个，AI 按你家情况拆解成今天就能做的三步。
tagline_en: Tantrums, homework battles, clashes—stop rereading parenting books. This skill turns your situation into three.
why_zh: 不空谈理论，先问清孩子年龄、场景、你的底线，再输出带时间点和话术的行动步骤，像有个贴身育儿教练。
why_en: No generic advice—it asks age, context, and your limits, then outputs timed, scripted actions. Like a pocket parenting coach.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 3-12 岁日常行为问题（哭闹、拖拉、顶嘴），不处理心理创伤、发育障碍或医疗建议；输出为行动清单。
limit_en: Covers only daily behavior issues (tantrums, dawdling, backtalk) for ages 3-12. No trauma, disorders, or medical advice. Outputs action lists, not.
